title: Nasty Liq Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Cherry Ice from Nasty Juice’s new Nasty Liq range offers vapers an exquisite cherry flavour with a refreshing icy twist. If you love bold fruit candy flavours, this could be your next favourite vape juice as it unleashes a burst of rich, sugary cherry bliss over your tastebuds. If you’re fond of cherry-flavoured sweets from the pick-n-mix, this flavour will definitely light up your tastebuds. This is chased by a bracing wave of icy Menthol – not too much, just enough to lift the experience even further and to bring a blast of crisp refreshment to this standout flavour. Indulgent, nostalgic, and just a bit naughty, Cherry Ice is a must-try for sugary fruit confectionary fans. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
